notes.title: Summer Update 1.8.5 & new game in development
notes.content:
Hello Again everyone 

[h1]Summer Update 1.8.5[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adding a new animation to the chainsaw enemy when you are finding the medicines.
[*] Adding more hints in the game.
[/list]

The next update it's the last of the game and the support.

Update 1.8.6: Autumn 2023.

[h2][u]Future plans:[/u][/h2]

It's a pleasure to show you the second game I'm working on. please add it to your wishlist.

[h1]Blue Maiden[/h1] is a Japanese first person psychological horror game that focuses on exploring and finding answers to the mystery of the old neighborhood.

[h3]Story[/h3]
You are Tachi Tachibana, a graduated university student, after graduating you decide to return to your neighborhood to help at the family business, you have been dreaming the same nightmare in which you find a mysterious girl, when You finally arrive in your neighborhood, you notice that something is not right, and you must find out what is happening.

[h3]Features[/h3]
Most of the time you have to walk and explore different traditional Japanese locations to find clues and solve the mystery of the Blue Maiden.

[list]
[*] [b]Immersive Experience:[/b] An Atmospheric Graphics.
[*] [b]Japanese Theme:[/b] Environment inspired by Japanese horror games.
[*] [b]Psychological horror:[/b] The game contains some jumpscares that could be disturbing.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UT4mGma.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EIw9UZ4.jpeg[/img]

Please add to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391690/Blue_Maiden/


Thanks for the support.

Blusagi Team.

notes.title: Locked in my darkness Release date
notes.content:
Hello again, first of all I want to thank you for your support and feedback in the trial period of the demo that took place last October, so I want to inform you that the release date of the game is going to be:

[h3]December 9, 2022.[/h3]

About the full game part of what was seen in the demo will be included with new exploration sections and a new puzzle plus several visual and translation bugs that were found in the demo have been fixed, thank you very much for your feedback.

Thank you very much to all.

Team Blusagi.
